title: Helios Retail - POC timeline & milestones
summary: POC scoping focused on timeline and milestones: kickoff, access setup, benchmark plan, mid-point review, and exec readout. Agreed on success criteria (latency/cost/accuracy), Helios to provide sample workloads and data access. Redwood to send SOW and benchmark plan. Tentative kickoff next week.
topics: Timeline & milestones (kickoff, access setup, midpoint, exec readout)
next_steps: Alex Chen: Send POC SOW and pricing (by 2025-10-17)
Priya Kapoor: Share benchmark plan and test harness (by 2025-10-20)
Leah Brooks (Helios): Provide sample queries, datasets, and access instructions (by 2025-10-18)
Schedule mid-point review (2 weeks after kickoff)
action_items: Alex Chen: Draft SOW + price sheet (due 2025-10-17)
Priya Kapoor: Prepare benchmark scripts and expected metrics doc (due 2025-10-20)
Leah Brooks: Upload 3 representative workloads + sample logs to S3 (due 2025-10-18)
Marta Ruiz: Confirm success criteria and exec readout attendee list (due 2025-10-20)
Jordan Li: Set up sandbox environment access and test accounts (due 2025-10-21)
header: Date: 2025-10-15 14:00 PDT | Duration: 52m | Attendees: Alex Chen (Redwood AE), Priya Kapoor (Redwood SE), Jordan Li (Redwood SE), Marta Ruiz (Helios Head of ML), Samir Patel (Helios CTO), Leah Brooks (Helios Data Eng), Rafael Ortiz (Helios Product)
transcript: 00:00 Alex Chen: Hey everyone, thanks for joining, um we wanted to run through the POC timeline and make sure success criteria is locked down
00:08 Marta Ruiz: Thanks Alex, yeah we are excited — we have a hard timeline for a vendor exec readout in about 4 weeks so need a tight plan
00:16 Samir Patel: Hi all, quick context: our main goal is to move inference for our search re-rank and chat assistance to a hosted model first, then evaluate dedicated if it makes sense

00:28 Priya Kapoor: Great, and for the POC we'll typically do a kickoff, access setup, run benchmarks on Helios workloads, a mid-point review, then exec readout — same template as our other retail POCs
00:40 Leah Brooks: Sounds good. On workloads we have three buckets: re-ranking QPS spikes, conversational chat with session context, and batch embeddings for recommendations

00:52 Alex Chen: Perfect — let's talk success criteria. From Redwood side we'd like to validate latency p95 and cost per 1M tokens, plus accuracy/QA on generated outputs. Any thresholds you have in mind?

01:05 Marta Ruiz: From product perspective p95 under 250ms for re-rank is ideal, p95 under 500ms for chat is okay, and embeddings batch throughput at least 2000 reqs/hr. Also quality: we need >=95% precision on top-k re-rank sample set
01:22 Jordan Li: Noted. For benchmarking we'll capture p50, p95, p99, tail latency, token cost, and model quality metrics against your eval set
01:35 Samir Patel: Cost is a big one — we'd like to see a projection for steady-state cost assuming our typical traffic, do you have a costing model?

01:43 Priya Kapoor: Yes we will run a cost projection. We'll share a cost-per-1M token estimate and a throughput cost model — also will explore dedicated vs hosted tradeoffs if cost or latency is outside your SLOs
01:57 Marta Ruiz: Also security constraints: Helios needs VPC peering or private link for data in the POC, SSO via SAML, and audit logs retained for 90 days. SOC 2 is required for live rollouts
02:10 Alex Chen: We can support VPC/private connectivity for the POC sandbox and share SOC 2 docs; SAML SSO is supported as well. We'll include operational setup steps in the kickoff checklist
02:22 Leah Brooks: For access we need service accounts and an IAM matrix — we can provide the contact for our infra team to coordinate peering
02:30 Priya Kapoor: Great — for the benchmark plan we'll need a sample of queries plus expected output examples, also any blacklists or PII considerations so we scrub properly
02:42 Marta Ruiz: We'll prepare a small sample dataset — about 5k queries for re-rank and 2k sessions for chat, plus the embedding corpus. We'll aim to upload by Friday

02:55 Alex Chen: Excellent. Timeline proposal: kickoff next week (we're thinking 2025-10-22), then 1 week for access/setup and initial runs, mid-point review 2 weeks after kickoff, final exec readout at end of week 4 — that matches your 4-week window?
03:12 Samir Patel: That sounds tight but doable if we can get access quickly. Who owns setup tasks?
03:20 Jordan Li: Redwood will provision sandbox infra and bench harness; Helios will provide datasets and IAM contacts. We'll finalize roles in the SOW
03:30 Marta Ruiz: Success criteria recap: p95 latency thresholds, embeddings throughput, quality metrics for re-rank. We'll also evaluate model regression vs our current baseline

03:43 Priya Kapoor: For regression tests we'll run automated evals and human spot checks; if we see a quality regression we'll flag it in the midpoint review and propose mitigations (prompt tuning, alternative model variants, quantization tradeoffs)
03:58 Leah Brooks: On the tech side, a question: does Redwood do prefix/KV cache for conversational sessions? We see lots of repeated prefixes
04:05 Priya Kapoor: Yes we have KV/prefix caching and workload-aware batching that we can enable; part of the bench is measuring effect of caching on p95 and cost
04:15 Marta Ruiz: Are there recommended model variants for lower cost? We use a trimmed hallucination-sensitive setup; we need to know tradeoffs for cheaper quantized models
04:26 Alex Chen: We'll include quantized variant results. We'll surface model/quantization recommendations in the benchmark report along with cost/latency tradeoffs
04:36 Samir Patel: On monitoring, we need per-route latency and token cost breakdown and traces to understand hotspots
04:43 Jordan Li: Redwood Console provides token-level cost and per-route dashboards; we'll share a sample dashboard and tracing hooks for your SREs
04:55 Marta Ruiz: Good. For the exec readout who from Helios should attend? I will get the product and infra leads, maybe the VP of engineering
05:03 Samir Patel: I'll be on the readout; we'll confirm the VP off schedule — likely present if we show clear cost wins
05:12 Priya Kapoor: Ok next steps: Redwood sends SOW + pricing, benchmark plan, and a kickoff checklist. Helios provides datasets, IAM contact, and success criteria confirmation
05:23 Alex Chen: I'll send the SOW by Friday (2025-10-17). Priya will send the benchmark plan by Monday (2025-10-20). Jordan will provision a sandbox account and test keys once we get IAM details
05:34 Leah Brooks: We'll upload the sample workloads by Saturday (2025-10-18) and share the infra contact for VPC peering
05:42 Marta Ruiz: One risk: if we can't do VPC peering in time, do you have a fallback?
05:48 Alex Chen: Yes fallback is tokenized secure upload to an encrypted S3 and Redwood runs tests in an isolated env; but VPC is preferred for live like conditions
05:58 Samir Patel: Also please include competitor comparison notes — we evaluated OpenAI and Anthropic already; we want to see where Redwood fits on latency/cost
06:06 Jordan Li: We'll include a short competitor appendix in the benchmark report — noting differences in routing, batching, and private deployment options
06:16 Alex Chen: Any other questions or items to capture?
06:20 Marta Ruiz: Not from me, just need the SOW and benchmark plan to align internal stakeholders
06:25 Samir Patel: Ditto — please include estimated costs for both Hosted and Dedicated run-rate scenarios
06:30 Priya Kapoor: Will do. We'll also provide a minimal test harness that you can run locally if you want to validate before our runs
06:40 Leah Brooks: That would help. Also please note any data retention requirements for logs and audit — we need 90 days as mentioned
06:48 Alex Chen: We'll include retention and KMS/HSM notes in the SOW and security appendix

06:55 Marta Ruiz: Ok cool. Recap of milestones: kickoff (2025-10-22), access setup complete (1 week), initial benchmark runs (week 2), mid-point review (two weeks after kickoff), final exec readout (end of week 4)
07:10 Alex Chen: I'll follow up with calendar invites and the SOW. Thanks everyone — we'll circulate next steps and owners in a follow-up email
07:20 Marta Ruiz: Thanks everyone, looking forward to the kickoff
07:24 Samir Patel: Thanks, bye
07:26 Priya Kapoor: Thanks all, bye
